remarks: UTILITIES INCLUDED-Fully Renovated 3BR in the Heart of Byram! Move right into this charming and private multi-level home tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac. This 3+ bedroom, 1.1 bathroom unit features a modern kitchen with new appliances, brand-new central air, new windows, new flooring, newly carpeted bedrooms, updated lighting, and a new in-unit washer and dryer. Flexible floor plan offers bonus space options and western-facing living area with sunset views, along with a private deck space. Enjoy an oversized 1-car garage with extra storage, additional street parking spots, and shared green space. Heat, water, cooking gas, electric, snow removal, grounds care, and trash are all included. Ideally situated near Mill Street, you'll enjoy convenient access to a variety of shops and restaurants, offering local dining and retail experiences in both Greenwich and Port Chester. This unit is also close to Byram Beach with its pool, park and splash pad, Shubert Library, and New Lebanon Elementary School. Easy access to I-95 and the train station. Available immediately, pet restrictions.
